title: CS bundle triage & rapid scoping cheatsheet for enterprise asks
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Create a compact, repeatable cheat-sheet and intake template for Sales/Customer Success to aggregate multiple enterprise feature requests, perform a fast first-pass scope (RICE-style), and escalate only the prioritized candidates to PM triage. This ticket captures the canonical fields, triage rubric, and a worked example that CS can use during discovery calls. Scope: non-bug, product/feature requests only. Out of scope: infra-only asks that require engineering capacity checks (these defer to ENG intake), urgent production incidents, and legal/compliance-only items (these go through security/compliance intake).
acceptance_criteria: A one-page intake template (Google Sheet) that CS can copy and complete during calls
A 5-step triage rubric with decision gates documented and examples
A short Confluence page that documents escalation rules and expected SLAs for PM response
Pilot with two AE/CS reps and one Solutions Engineer; at least three real requests processed using the template
Handoff checklist for PM review containing required artifacts (customer context, success metrics, sample prompt/workload, LOE estimate or blockers)
decision_log: 2026-01-26: Decided to keep the initial template to a single sheet to reduce friction (Aisha, Liam, Sofia)

2026-02-10: Opted to exclude dedicated infra feasibility checks from CS scope; add ENG-2893 as dependency instead (Eng lead: Ben Carter)
